collection.title: BMW 3 Series Convertible 2000 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 2000 to 2006 version of a BMW 3 Series Convertible requires a 23" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
